rationale.text: The html element carries lang with an empty value. The first condition asks that the indication be given for the html element with the lang attribute; the text does not say whether an empty attribute gives it. The custom check answers cannot_tell (step 2); only the record supports this branch. axe's html-has-lang faults on an empty lang, through an evidence-only link, so the reason at full is alternative_unresolved; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled.

citations.quote: L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée pour l’élément `html`
